citaat: I think we would need the 'additional context files' functionality to roll this out company-wide. Could we enrol in January with 1 user and then upgrade once this functionality is introduced and we are ready to use company-wide?
samenvatting: Zonder uploaden van contextdocumenten geen bedrijfsbrede uitrol, dat is de blocker.

citaat: I created an assessment in the OTJ course on my login. I found a learner whom a tutor had asked to submit it several times after feedback. I have also attached the GPT chat to create the rubric PDF for your reference.
samenvatting: Hij bouwt zijn rubrics zelf met ChatGPT en test op echte OTJ-logs.

citaat: Yes I agree and that is our stance also - we use turn it in.
samenvatting: Turnitin staat er al, AI-detectie op percentage willen ze niet.

citaat: If the assumption is tutors are reviewing why not make sure they have to at least scroll through fully. People are lazy and will quickly pick up they don't have to. Or have a tick box for tutor to sign to say they agree with the feedback so we can hold them to account?
samenvatting: Wil afdwingen dat tutors de AI-feedback echt lezen en tekenen.

citaat: For the feedback quality, the benchmark for us is that it is educationally sound, assessment-valid, and aligned with apprenticeship standards and EPA expectations. Feedback must clearly support learning, withstand external scrutiny (including Ofsted and EPA), and not require substantive assessor intervention beyond light editorial refinement.
samenvatting: Zijn maatstaf is Ofsted- en EPA-bestendige feedback, niet tijdwinst alleen.

citaat: In terms of time saved, a qualitative reduction in grading effort is sufficient at this stage, but it needs to be clearly demonstrable and consistent across multiple off-the-job logs rather than anecdotal.
samenvatting: Tijdwinst moet aantoonbaar en herhaalbaar zijn over meerdere logs.

citaat: At present, I don't think we are quite there yet on the first point, which is why further refinement of the rubrics and outputs feels necessary before we can fairly judge the POV.
samenvatting: Feedbackkwaliteit haalde zijn norm nog niet, rubrics moesten verder verfijnd.

citaat: We have tried but have had more joy in creating our own GPT in ChatGPT to create the relevant outputs. Are we any closer to the ability to upload none pdf docs and being able to upload reference documents?
samenvatting: Eigen GPT in ChatGPT werd hun werkende oplossing naast onze tool.

citaat: Gets to a point where I can only play with it for so long. Getting this automated on Eduface would further improve the process efficiency-wise, but I cant get it to that point on my own.
samenvatting: Zijn eigen bouwsel loopt vast, hij komt er alleen niet verder mee.

citaat: We have been notified that our inspection by Ofsted will occur next week, so I am having to clear my diary for the week to aid preparation.
samenvatting: Ofsted-inspectie legt zijn hele agenda plat, dat vertraagt elk traject.

citaat: We have a process which is working quite well for us via Chat GPT now. I do not see any value in continuing to play at the edges with Edu face at this moment. I feel we need to park this as a project for now.
samenvatting: Verloren op hun eigen ChatGPT-proces, dit is de letterlijke afwijsreden.

citaat: Yes happy to do further testing as the system evolves.
samenvatting: Deur staat open zodra de contextdocument-functie er echt is.
